Revenue test evidence (E) is derived from conversion rate (C) and pricing clarity (P), such that E = h(C, P). The build card state transition (S) operates under a Markovian process with dependency weight D and time T, where P(S_i → S_j) = f(D, T). These operators form a dual system: one for probabilistic trust (GSI) and one for operational execution (GSE). Failure modes include unverified P0 data, missing tests, and compliance blockers, which act as singularities in the readiness lattice. The system exhibits anti-collinearity between test coverage and blocker count, with a shared dependency on real-world implementation state.
